action.prompt:
Before finishing, determine whether changes made during this session affect the project's public documentation.

If project functionality, architecture, setup, dependencies, configuration, environment variables, folder structure, deployment, Docker configuration, public API surface, or user-facing behaviour changed, update README.md.

Do not update README.md for formatting-only changes, internal refactoring, code style changes, comments, or bug fixes that do not change the project's public interface.

Follow the readme-standards steering file for structure, content, and documentation quality.

Preserve manually written sections whenever possible. Update only the sections affected by the current changes.

Provide a brief summary of what was updated.
